svg.title: One process of shared state, or two that share an artifact
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “One process of shared state, or two that share an artifact” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. On the left a notebook page of numbered cells up to forty-seven with red backward arrows showing out-of-order execution, sitting inside a dashed blob labelled kernel state, and a struck-out arrow running the notebook in production; on the right, across a dashed boundary, train.py and predict.py share only a versioned artifact whose manifest lists model.onnx, classes.json, preprocess_version, git_sha, metrics.json and input_schema, plus one circled preprocess.py imported by both, and bars comparing 3,140 MB of training dependencies with 466 MB of serving dependencies.
svg.text: One process of shared state, or two that share an artifact
draw it from memory, then compare
